result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. A few visual issues were found, mostly related to text truncation and partially clipped horizontal-scroll items, plus a minor content inconsistency in the delivery info shown across sections.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' shows the name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off abruptly without an ellipsis, making the truncation look like a rendering bug rather than intentional overflow handling.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or equivalent) to card titles so truncated names end with '…', or allow the title to wrap to a second line.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge with only a small sliver visible, which can look broken and may not clearly signal horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so a larger, recognizable portion of the next chip is visible (peek pattern), or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('-20%') is cut off mid-image by the bottom navigation bar, leaving a partially visible card with no name or details.
issues.suggestion: This is likely just scroll position, but ensure adequate bottom padding so content isn't obscured by the nav bar and cards don't appear abruptly cropped.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' cards show only delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, time, fee, and cuisine — the inconsistent information density can feel unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding delivery time or rating consistently across card types, or intentionally style compact cards differently so the missing info doesn't look like an omission.

issues.description: Grey secondary text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') appears low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for small text.
